description:
Watch British Tourists Try American Chinese Food For The First Time.

These reactions show what happens when expectations meet reality. Some moments are funny and some are confusing. Others show how quickly a person’s opinion can change once they experience America for themselves. Comment down below and tell us what surprised you most.

👍 If you enjoy British reactions to America, don't forget to Like, Subscribe, and turn on notifications for more UK vs USA culture shock videos, travel reactions and everyday American discoveries every week.

#AmericanChineseFood #BritishTourists #BritsReact #AmericanFood #ChineseFood #FoodReaction #FoodCulture #PandaExpress #Travel #UnitedStates #Foodies #ReactionVideo #usa #EverydayAmerica #funny #viral #shock #uk #BritishReact #CultureShock #BritishVsAmerican #AmericanCulture #USATravel #AmericanLife

Why do you say that? why isn't it Chinese cuisine. I think it's American Chinese cuisine for sure American Chinese cuisine is a unique food tradition entirely invented in the United States, eg Orange Chicken was invented by a chef at a Panda Express in Hawaii in 1987 facts.
General Tso's chicken was created and popularized in NYC. Chop suey was created in California during the gold rush Crab ragoon created in California Fortune Cookies is pure American, China, Chinese have no idea what a fortune cookie is, Egg rolls were created in NY, in China it's called spring rolls and it's  different etc.
Folks confuse Cuisine and food.Chinese food is an umbrella term for anything eaten in China, while American Chinese cuisine is a distinct, structured culinary system created in the United States. 😊
